check_assur_melacha.description: Check whether a moment falls inside Shabbat or a Yom Tov, when work is forbidden. This is the question a scheduler actually asks: not 'is it Saturday?' but 'may this run now?'. description: Look up anything on the Jewish calendar. Get holidays for any year, candle lighting and Havdalah times for any city, the weekly Torah portion with its aliyot and haftarah, Daf Yomi and fifteen other daily learning cycles, the count of the Omer, the halachic times of the day, yahrzeit and Hebrew birthday dates, and conversion between Hebrew and ordinary dates either way. It can also answer whether a given moment falls in Shabbat or a festival, so a workflow can hold off until it ends. No account or API key is required.
